title: Nick Tilsen, Organizing Through Collapse
author: Cinnamon Janzer
content:
Nick Tilsen has been under indictment for six of the eight years that his
organization has existed. The founder and CEO of NDN Collective, a Rapid City-
based organization dedicated to building Indigenous power, Tilsen explains it
this way: “They’re threatened. They’re not used to Indian people being able to
fight back in their systems,” referring most recently to his time in a South
Dakota courtroom earlier this year.
